title: Shattered Orb Over Ruins
description: A cracked golden sphere with glowing orange fissures and cartoonish black eyes floats at the center of the composition. It is surrounded by an explosion of colorful spears, swords, and debris radiating outward against a dark, apocalyptic background of ruined gothic spires and a reflective body of water below.
prompt: A cracked golden sphere with large black cartoon eyes and glowing orange fissures floats in the center of a surreal apocalyptic scene. Colorful spears, swords, and sharp debris explode outward from the orb in all directions. Dark gothic ruined spires rise in the background under a dramatic red and teal sky, with a reflective body of water below showing the orb's glow, painterly brushstrokes, moody cinematic lighting
